senses.gloss: (b. h., I Chr. IV, 18) pr. n. f. Bithiah, daughter of Pharaoh; in legend, name of Moses’ foster-mother.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:3">Lev. R. s. 1</cite>, a. e (as if <he>בַּת יָהּ</he> daughter of the Lord, pious).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 31b:17">Snh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>לדזיו ליה כבר ב׳ שלם</he> salutation to him whose splendor is like that of the son of B. (Moses).
